verdict.rationale: Cerebras docs explicitly state existing OpenAI-based applications can switch to Cerebras by changing only the API key, base URL, and model ID, and marketing material reiterates 'just two code changes,' backed by an official OpenAI-compatible SDK/resources page. Community reports confirm successful drop-in use via tools like llm-cerebras and OpenRouter, though one comment notes a wrong_api_format error in a third-party router integration, suggesting minor edge-case friction rather than a fundamental compatibility failure. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a pure base-URL swap with the official OpenAI SDK (not just plugins/routers), and no public OpenAPI spec to cross-verify parameter parity.
